This Application has been filed for quashing the entire proceedings of Complaint Case No.3156 of 2023, "Smt. Shivani vs. Ashish", pending before the court of learned Ist Additional Judicial Magistrate, Roorkee, District Haridwar under Section 498A of the Indian Penal Code, 1860.

entities.text: Ist Additional Judicial Magistrate, Roorkee, District Haridwar
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
2. Heard Mr. M.K. Ray, learned counsel with Mr. Harsh Taneja, learned counsel for the applicant and Mrs. Sweta Badola Dobhal, learned Brief Holder for the respondent no.1.
3.
Mr. M.K. Ray, Advocate contended that all the allegations of the complaint case are false.

Applicant is still ready to live with his wife, the respondent no.2.
4.
Notice is being issued to the respondent no.2.
Steps to be taken with three days.
Till then, further proceedings of Complaint Case No.3156 of 2023 are stayed.
6. The applicant and the respondent no.2 are directed to appear in-person before this Court on 16.12.2025.

(Alok Kumar Verma, J.)
